en.g: Name the twelve months and say dates in British and American style.
p: January to December always start with a capital letter.
Use in for months (in May) and on for dates (on the third of May).
British people say the third of May; Americans often say May third.
en.q: When is your birthday? Say the full date in English.
en.c: Say aloud the dates of three birthdays in your family, in English.

de.g: Du lernst die zwölf Monate und sagst ein Datum auf britische und amerikanische Art.
p: January bis December schreibt man immer groß.
In steht vor Monaten (in May), on vor einem Datum (on the third of May).
Briten sagen the third of May, Amerikaner oft May third.
de.q: Wann hast du Geburtstag? Sag das ganze Datum auf Englisch.
de.c: Sag heute laut auf Englisch die Geburtstage von drei Familienmitgliedern.

es.g: Aprende los doce meses y a decir fechas al estilo británico y americano.
p: De January a December siempre van con mayúscula.
Usa in con meses (in May) y on con fechas (on the third of May).
En el Reino Unido se dice the third of May; en EE. UU., a menudo May third.
es.q: ¿Cuándo es tu cumpleaños? Di la fecha completa en inglés.
es.c: Di en voz alta en inglés las fechas de tres cumpleaños de tu familia.

fr.g: Nommer les douze mois et dire une date à la britannique et à l'américaine.
p: De January à December, toujours une majuscule.
In devant les mois (in May), on devant une date (on the third of May).
Les Britanniques disent the third of May, les Américains souvent May third.
fr.q: Quand est ton anniversaire ? Dis la date complète en anglais.
fr.c: Dis à voix haute en anglais la date de trois anniversaires de ta famille.

it.g: Impari i dodici mesi e a dire le date all'inglese e all'americana.
p: Da January a December hanno sempre la maiuscola.
In davanti ai mesi (in May), on davanti alle date (on the third of May).
Gli inglesi dicono the third of May, gli americani spesso May third.
it.q: Quando è il tuo compleanno? Di' la data completa in inglese.
it.c: Di' ad alta voce in inglese le date di tre compleanni della tua famiglia.

pt.g: Aprende os doze meses e a dizer datas à maneira britânica e americana.
p: De January a December levam sempre maiúscula.
In antes dos meses (in May) e on antes das datas (on the third of May).
Os britânicos dizem the third of May; os americanos muitas vezes May third.
pt.q: Quando fazes anos? Diz a data completa em inglês.
pt.c: Diz em voz alta, em inglês, as datas de três aniversários da tua família.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda os doze meses e a dizer datas no estilo britânico e americano.
p: De January a December sempre têm maiúscula.
In antes dos meses (in May) e on antes das datas (on the third of May).
Britânicos dizem the third of May; americanos costumam dizer May third.
pt_BR.q: Quando é o seu aniversário? Diga a data completa em inglês.
pt_BR.c: Fale em voz alta, em inglês, as datas de três aniversários da sua família.

vocab.ex: The party is on the third of May.

target.gram: In + month (in July), on + date (on the 5th of July). Ordinals: first, second, third, fourth, fifth.

en.g: Ask and tell the time in English, both the easy and the classic way.
p: Ask What time is it? and answer It's seven o'clock.
Classic style: half past six (6:30), quarter past nine (9:15), quarter to nine (8:45).
Easy style: just read the digits, six thirty, nine fifteen; use at for times: at 8.
en.q: What time do you usually wake up? Say it in two ways.
en.c: Each time you look at a clock today, say the time in English.

de.g: Du lernst, auf Englisch nach der Uhrzeit zu fragen und sie zu sagen, einfach und klassisch.
p: Frag What time is it? und antworte It's seven o'clock.
Klassisch: half past six (6:30), quarter past nine (9:15), quarter to nine (8:45).
Einfach: Ziffern lesen, six thirty, nine fifteen. Achtung: half past six ist 6:30, nicht 5:30.
de.q: Wann stehst du normalerweise auf? Sag es auf zwei Arten.
de.c: Sag heute jedes Mal, wenn du auf die Uhr schaust, die Zeit auf Englisch.

es.g: Aprende a preguntar y decir la hora en inglés, de forma fácil y clásica.
p: Pregunta What time is it? y responde It's seven o'clock.
Estilo clásico: half past six (6:30), quarter past nine (9:15), quarter to nine (8:45).
Estilo fácil: lee las cifras, six thirty, nine fifteen; usa at con horas: at 8.
es.q: ¿A qué hora te levantas normalmente? Dilo de dos maneras.
es.c: Cada vez que mires un reloj hoy, di la hora en inglés.

fr.g: Demander et dire l'heure en anglais, de façon simple et classique.
p: Demande What time is it? et réponds It's seven o'clock.
Classique : half past six (6 h 30), quarter past nine (9 h 15), quarter to nine (8 h 45).
Simple : lis les chiffres, six thirty, nine fifteen ; avec une heure, on dit at : at 8.
fr.q: À quelle heure te lèves-tu d'habitude ? Dis-le de deux façons.
fr.c: Chaque fois que tu regardes une horloge aujourd'hui, dis l'heure en anglais.

it.g: Impari a chiedere e dire l'ora in inglese, in modo semplice e classico.
p: Chiedi What time is it? e rispondi It's seven o'clock.
Classico: half past six (6:30), quarter past nine (9:15), quarter to nine (8:45).
Semplice: leggi le cifre, six thirty, nine fifteen; con gli orari si usa at: at 8.
it.q: A che ora ti svegli di solito? Dillo in due modi.
it.c: Ogni volta che guardi un orologio oggi, di' l'ora in inglese.

pt.g: Aprende a perguntar e a dizer as horas em inglês, da forma fácil e da clássica.
p: Pergunta What time is it? e responde It's seven o'clock.
Clássica: half past six (6:30), quarter past nine (9:15), quarter to nine (8:45).
Fácil: lê os números, six thirty, nine fifteen; com horas usa-se at: at 8.
pt.q: A que horas acordas normalmente? Diz de duas maneiras.
pt.c: Sempre que olhares para um relógio hoje, diz as horas em inglês.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda a perguntar e dizer as horas em inglês, do jeito fácil e do clássico.
p: Pergunte What time is it? e responda It's seven o'clock.
Clássico: half past six (6:30), quarter past nine (9:15), quarter to nine (8:45).
Fácil: leia os números, six thirty, nine fifteen; com horários use at: at 8.
pt_BR.q: Que horas você costuma acordar? Diga de duas maneiras.
pt_BR.c: Toda vez que olhar para um relógio hoje, diga as horas em inglês.

vocab.ex: Excuse me, what time is it?
The film starts at half past seven.
I leave at quarter to eight.

target.gram: It's + time: It's half past two. At + time for events: The class starts at nine.

en.t: Present simple: I work, I live
en.g: Use the present simple for facts and habits with I, you, we and they.
p: The present simple is for routines and facts: I work in an office.
With I, you, we and they the verb stays in its base form: we live, they play.
Time words help: every day, on Mondays, in the morning.
en.q: Tell me three things you do every week, starting with I.
en.c: Write five true sentences about your life with I and the present simple.

de.t: Present simple: I work, I live
de.g: Du lernst das present simple für Fakten und Gewohnheiten mit I, you, we und they.
p: Das present simple steht für Routinen und Fakten: I work in an office.
Mit I, you, we und they bleibt das Verb in der Grundform: we live, they play.
Zeitwörter helfen: every day, on Mondays, in the morning.
de.q: Nenn mir drei Dinge, die du jede Woche machst, mit I am Anfang.
de.c: Schreib fünf wahre Sätze über dein Leben mit I im present simple.

es.t: Present simple: I work, I live
es.g: Aprende el present simple para hechos y hábitos con I, you, we y they.
p: El present simple sirve para rutinas y hechos: I work in an office.
Con I, you, we y they el verbo no cambia: we live, they play.
Ayudan las expresiones de tiempo: every day, on Mondays, in the morning.
es.q: Dime tres cosas que haces cada semana, empezando por I.
es.c: Escribe cinco frases verdaderas sobre tu vida con I y el present simple.

fr.t: Present simple : I work, I live
fr.g: Utiliser le present simple pour les faits et habitudes avec I, you, we et they.
p: Le present simple exprime routines et faits : I work in an office.
Avec I, you, we et they, le verbe reste à la forme de base : we live, they play.
Les mots de temps aident : every day, on Mondays, in the morning.
fr.q: Dis-moi trois choses que tu fais chaque semaine, en commençant par I.
fr.c: Écris cinq phrases vraies sur ta vie avec I et le present simple.

it.t: Present simple: I work, I live
it.g: Impari il present simple per fatti e abitudini con I, you, we e they.
p: Il present simple indica routine e fatti: I work in an office.
Con I, you, we e they il verbo resta alla forma base: we live, they play.
Aiutano le espressioni di tempo: every day, on Mondays, in the morning.
it.q: Dimmi tre cose che fai ogni settimana, iniziando con I.
it.c: Scrivi cinque frasi vere sulla tua vita con I e il present simple.

pt.t: Present simple: I work, I live
pt.g: Aprende o present simple para factos e hábitos com I, you, we e they.
p: O present simple serve para rotinas e factos: I work in an office.
Com I, you, we e they o verbo fica na forma base: we live, they play.
As expressões de tempo ajudam: every day, on Mondays, in the morning.
pt.q: Diz-me três coisas que fazes todas as semanas, a começar por I.
pt.c: Escreve cinco frases verdadeiras sobre a tua vida com I e o present simple.

pt_BR.t: Present simple: I work, I live
pt_BR.g: Aprenda o present simple para fatos e hábitos com I, you, we e they.
p: O present simple serve para rotinas e fatos: I work in an office.
Com I, you, we e they o verbo fica na forma base: we live, they play.
Expressões de tempo ajudam: every day, on Mondays, in the morning.
pt_BR.q: Me diga três coisas que você faz toda semana, começando com I.
pt_BR.c: Escreva cinco frases verdadeiras sobre sua vida com I e o present simple.

vocab.ex: I speak Portuguese and a little English.
You play the guitar very well.
I walk to work every day.

target.gram: Present simple with I/you/we/they: base verb. I work. We study. They live in Spain.

en.t: Present simple: he works, she lives
en.g: Add -s or -es to the verb with he, she and it in the present simple.
p: With he, she and it add -s: she works, he lives, it rains.
After -s, -sh, -ch, -o add -es: he watches, she goes, it fixes.
Learn the special forms: have becomes has, do becomes does, go becomes goes.
en.q: Tell me about a friend: what does he or she do every day?
en.c: Write five sentences about one person you know, adding -s each time.

de.t: Present simple: he works, she lives
de.g: Du lernst, im present simple bei he, she und it -s oder -es anzuhängen.
p: Bei he, she und it kommt ein -s dazu: she works, he lives, it rains.
Nach -s, -sh, -ch, -o kommt -es: he watches, she goes, it fixes.
Merk dir die Sonderformen: have wird has, do wird does, go wird goes.
de.q: Erzähl von einem Freund: Was macht er oder sie jeden Tag?
de.c: Schreib fünf Sätze über eine Person, die du kennst, jedes Mal mit -s.

es.t: Present simple: he works, she lives
es.g: Aprende a añadir -s o -es al verbo con he, she e it en present simple.
p: Con he, she e it se añade -s: she works, he lives, it rains.
Tras -s, -sh, -ch, -o se añade -es: he watches, she goes, it fixes.
Aprende las formas especiales: have pasa a has, do a does, go a goes.
es.q: Háblame de un amigo: ¿qué hace él o ella cada día?
es.c: Escribe cinco frases sobre una persona que conoces, añadiendo la -s cada vez.

fr.t: Present simple : he works, she lives
fr.g: Ajouter -s ou -es au verbe avec he, she et it au present simple.
p: Avec he, she et it, on ajoute -s : she works, he lives, it rains.
Après -s, -sh, -ch, -o, on ajoute -es : he watches, she goes, it fixes.
Retiens les formes spéciales : have devient has, do devient does, go devient goes.
fr.q: Parle-moi d'un ami : que fait-il ou que fait-elle chaque jour ?
fr.c: Écris cinq phrases sur une personne que tu connais, avec le -s à chaque fois.

it.t: Present simple: he works, she lives
it.g: Impari ad aggiungere -s o -es al verbo con he, she e it nel present simple.
p: Con he, she e it si aggiunge -s: she works, he lives, it rains.
Dopo -s, -sh, -ch, -o si aggiunge -es: he watches, she goes, it fixes.
Impara le forme speciali: have diventa has, do diventa does, go diventa goes.
it.q: Parlami di un amico: cosa fa lui o lei ogni giorno?
it.c: Scrivi cinque frasi su una persona che conosci, aggiungendo la -s ogni volta.

pt.t: Present simple: he works, she lives
pt.g: Aprende a juntar -s ou -es ao verbo com he, she e it no present simple.
p: Com he, she e it junta-se -s: she works, he lives, it rains.
Depois de -s, -sh, -ch, -o junta-se -es: he watches, she goes, it fixes.
Aprende as formas especiais: have passa a has, do a does, go a goes.
pt.q: Fala-me de um amigo: o que é que ele ou ela faz todos os dias?
pt.c: Escreve cinco frases sobre uma pessoa que conheces, sempre com o -s.

pt_BR.t: Present simple: he works, she lives
pt_BR.g: Aprenda a colocar -s ou -es no verbo com he, she e it no present simple.
p: Com he, she e it acrescenta-se -s: she works, he lives, it rains.
Depois de -s, -sh, -ch, -o acrescenta-se -es: he watches, she goes, it fixes.
Aprenda as formas especiais: have vira has, do vira does, go vira goes.
pt_BR.q: Me fale de um amigo: o que ele ou ela faz todo dia?
pt_BR.c: Escreva cinco frases sobre uma pessoa que você conhece, sempre com o -s.

vocab.ex: My sister works in a hotel.
He goes to school by bike.
My dad has a big garden.
She does her homework at six.

target.gram: He/she/it + verb-s: she plays, he watches, it goes. Special: have-has, do-does, go-goes.

en.g: Describe a normal day from morning to night in English.
p: Morning: wake up, get up, have a shower, have breakfast.
Day: go to work or school, have lunch, finish work, come home.
Evening: cook dinner, watch TV, go to bed; join them with then and after that.
en.q: What does a normal weekday look like for you?
en.c: Tell your whole day aloud in English in six short sentences.

de.g: Du lernst, einen normalen Tag von morgens bis abends auf Englisch zu beschreiben.
p: Morgens: wake up, get up, have a shower, have breakfast.
Tagsüber: go to work oder school, have lunch, finish work, come home.
Abends: cook dinner, watch TV, go to bed; verbinde mit then und after that.
de.q: Wie sieht ein normaler Wochentag bei dir aus?
de.c: Erzähl deinen ganzen Tag laut auf Englisch in sechs kurzen Sätzen.

es.g: Aprende a describir un día normal de la mañana a la noche en inglés.
p: Mañana: wake up, get up, have a shower, have breakfast.
Día: go to work o school, have lunch, finish work, come home.
Noche: cook dinner, watch TV, go to bed; únelos con then y after that.
es.q: ¿Cómo es un día normal entre semana para ti?
es.c: Cuenta tu día entero en voz alta en inglés en seis frases cortas.

fr.g: Décrire une journée ordinaire du matin au soir en anglais.
p: Le matin : wake up, get up, have a shower, have breakfast.
La journée : go to work ou school, have lunch, finish work, come home.
Le soir : cook dinner, watch TV, go to bed ; relie-les avec then et after that.
fr.q: À quoi ressemble une journée de semaine ordinaire pour toi ?
fr.c: Raconte toute ta journée à voix haute en anglais en six phrases courtes.

it.g: Impari a descrivere una giornata normale dalla mattina alla sera in inglese.
p: Mattina: wake up, get up, have a shower, have breakfast.
Giorno: go to work o school, have lunch, finish work, come home.
Sera: cook dinner, watch TV, go to bed; collegali con then e after that.
it.q: Com'è una tua giornata feriale normale?
it.c: Racconta tutta la tua giornata ad alta voce in inglese in sei frasi brevi.

pt.g: Aprende a descrever um dia normal, de manhã à noite, em inglês.
p: Manhã: wake up, get up, have a shower, have breakfast.
Dia: go to work ou school, have lunch, finish work, come home.
Noite: cook dinner, watch TV, go to bed; liga-os com then e after that.
pt.q: Como é um dia de semana normal para ti?
pt.c: Conta o teu dia inteiro em voz alta em inglês, em seis frases curtas.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda a descrever um dia normal, de manhã à noite, em inglês.
p: Manhã: wake up, get up, have a shower, have breakfast.
Dia: go to work ou school, have lunch, finish work, come home.
Noite: cook dinner, watch TV, go to bed; ligue tudo com then e after that.
pt_BR.q: Como é um dia de semana normal para você?
pt_BR.c: Conte seu dia inteiro em voz alta em inglês, em seis frases curtas.

vocab.ex: She gets up at half past six.
He goes to work by train.
They go to bed at eleven.

target.gram: Routines use the present simple: I get up at 7, then I have breakfast. After that, I go to work.

en.g: Ask yes/no questions in the present simple with do and does.
p: Use do with I, you, we, they: Do you like tea?
Use does with he, she, it, and the verb loses its -s: Does she work here?
Short answers: Yes, I do. No, she doesn't.
en.q: Do you like coffee? Answer me, then ask me a question with does.
en.c: Ask someone, or me, three questions starting with Do you...?

de.g: Du lernst Ja/Nein-Fragen im present simple mit do und does.
p: Do für I, you, we, they: Do you like tea?
Does für he, she, it, und das Verb verliert sein -s: Does she work here?
Kurzantworten: Yes, I do. No, she doesn't.
de.q: Do you like coffee? Antworte und stell mir dann eine Frage mit does.
de.c: Stell heute jemandem, oder mir, drei Fragen mit Do you...?

es.g: Aprende a hacer preguntas de sí o no en present simple con do y does.
p: Do con I, you, we, they: Do you like tea?
Does con he, she, it, y el verbo pierde la -s: Does she work here?
Respuestas cortas: Yes, I do. No, she doesn't.
es.q: Do you like coffee? Contéstame y luego hazme una pregunta con does.
es.c: Hazle hoy a alguien, o a mí, tres preguntas que empiecen por Do you...?

fr.g: Poser des questions fermées au present simple avec do et does.
p: Do avec I, you, we, they : Do you like tea?
Does avec he, she, it, et le verbe perd son -s : Does she work here?
Réponses courtes : Yes, I do. No, she doesn't.
fr.q: Do you like coffee? Réponds-moi, puis pose-moi une question avec does.
fr.c: Pose aujourd'hui trois questions commençant par Do you...? à quelqu'un, ou à moi.

it.g: Impari a fare domande sì/no nel present simple con do e does.
p: Do con I, you, we, they: Do you like tea?
Does con he, she, it, e il verbo perde la -s: Does she work here?
Risposte brevi: Yes, I do. No, she doesn't.
it.q: Do you like coffee? Rispondimi e poi fammi una domanda con does.
it.c: Fai oggi a qualcuno, o a me, tre domande che iniziano con Do you...?

pt.g: Aprende a fazer perguntas de sim ou não no present simple com do e does.
p: Do com I, you, we, they: Do you like tea?
Does com he, she, it, e o verbo perde o -s: Does she work here?
Respostas curtas: Yes, I do. No, she doesn't.
pt.q: Do you like coffee? Responde-me e depois faz-me uma pergunta com does.
pt.c: Faz hoje a alguém, ou a mim, três perguntas a começar por Do you...?

pt_BR.g: Aprenda a fazer perguntas de sim ou não no present simple com do e does.
p: Do com I, you, we, they: Do you like tea?
Does com he, she, it, e o verbo perde o -s: Does she work here?
Respostas curtas: Yes, I do. No, she doesn't.
pt_BR.q: Do you like coffee? Me responda e depois me faça uma pergunta com does.
pt_BR.c: Faça hoje para alguém, ou para mim, três perguntas começando com Do you...?

vocab.ex: Do you like music? Yes, I do.
Does he drive? No, he doesn't.

target.gram: Do/Does + subject + base verb: Does he play tennis? (not Does he plays). Short answer: Yes, he does.

en.g: Say what is not true in the present simple with don't and doesn't.
p: Use don't (do not) with I, you, we, they: I don't drink coffee.
Use doesn't (does not) with he, she, it: He doesn't live here.
After doesn't the verb has no -s: she doesn't like, not she doesn't likes.
en.q: Tell me two things you don't do and one thing your friend doesn't do.
en.c: Write three true negative sentences about yourself and two about someone else.

de.g: Du lernst, im present simple mit don't und doesn't zu verneinen.
p: Don't (do not) für I, you, we, they: I don't drink coffee.
Doesn't (does not) für he, she, it: He doesn't live here.
Nach doesn't hat das Verb kein -s: she doesn't like, nicht she doesn't likes.
de.q: Nenn mir zwei Dinge, die du nicht machst, und eins, das dein Freund nicht macht.
de.c: Schreib drei wahre verneinte Sätze über dich und zwei über jemand anderen.

es.g: Aprende a negar en present simple con don't y doesn't.
p: Don't (do not) con I, you, we, they: I don't drink coffee.
Doesn't (does not) con he, she, it: He doesn't live here.
Tras doesn't el verbo no lleva -s: she doesn't like, no she doesn't likes.
es.q: Dime dos cosas que no haces y una que no hace tu amigo.
es.c: Escribe tres frases negativas verdaderas sobre ti y dos sobre otra persona.

fr.g: Dire ce qui n'est pas vrai au present simple avec don't et doesn't.
p: Don't (do not) avec I, you, we, they : I don't drink coffee.
Doesn't (does not) avec he, she, it : He doesn't live here.
Après doesn't, le verbe n'a pas de -s : she doesn't like, pas she doesn't likes.
fr.q: Dis-moi deux choses que tu ne fais pas et une que ton ami ne fait pas.
fr.c: Écris trois phrases négatives vraies sur toi et deux sur quelqu'un d'autre.

it.g: Impari a dire ciò che non è vero nel present simple con don't e doesn't.
p: Don't (do not) con I, you, we, they: I don't drink coffee.
Doesn't (does not) con he, she, it: He doesn't live here.
Dopo doesn't il verbo non ha la -s: she doesn't like, non she doesn't likes.
it.q: Dimmi due cose che non fai e una che il tuo amico non fa.
it.c: Scrivi tre frasi negative vere su di te e due su un'altra persona.

pt.g: Aprende a negar no present simple com don't e doesn't.
p: Don't (do not) com I, you, we, they: I don't drink coffee.
Doesn't (does not) com he, she, it: He doesn't live here.
Depois de doesn't o verbo não leva -s: she doesn't like, e não she doesn't likes.
pt.q: Diz-me duas coisas que não fazes e uma que o teu amigo não faz.
pt.c: Escreve três frases negativas verdadeiras sobre ti e duas sobre outra pessoa.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda a negar no present simple com don't e doesn't.
p: Don't (do not) com I, you, we, they: I don't drink coffee.
Doesn't (does not) com he, she, it: He doesn't live here.
Depois de doesn't o verbo fica sem -s: she doesn't like, e não she doesn't likes.
pt_BR.q: Me diga duas coisas que você não faz e uma que seu amigo não faz.
pt_BR.c: Escreva três frases negativas verdadeiras sobre você e duas sobre outra pessoa.

vocab.ex: We don't drink coffee at night.

target.gram: Negative: subject + don't/doesn't + base verb. He doesn't work here (not He doesn't works).

en.g: Say what you do for a living and where you work.
p: Use a or an with jobs: I'm a teacher, she's an engineer.
Ask What do you do? to ask about someone's job.
Say where: A nurse works in a hospital; a chef works in a restaurant.
en.q: What do you do, or what would you love to do one day?
en.c: Name five jobs of people you know and say where each one works.

de.g: Du lernst zu sagen, was du beruflich machst und wo du arbeitest.
p: Vor Berufen steht a oder an: I'm a teacher, she's an engineer.
Frag What do you do?, um nach dem Beruf zu fragen.
Sag den Ort: A nurse works in a hospital; a chef works in a restaurant.
de.q: Was machst du beruflich, oder was würdest du gern einmal machen?
de.c: Nenn fünf Berufe von Menschen, die du kennst, und wo sie arbeiten.

es.g: Aprende a decir a qué te dedicas y dónde trabajas.
p: Con las profesiones se usa a o an: I'm a teacher, she's an engineer.
Pregunta What do you do? para saber a qué se dedica alguien.
Di el lugar: A nurse works in a hospital; a chef works in a restaurant.
es.q: ¿A qué te dedicas, o a qué te encantaría dedicarte algún día?
es.c: Nombra cinco profesiones de gente que conoces y dónde trabaja cada uno.

fr.g: Dire quel est ton métier et où tu travailles.
p: Devant un métier, on met a ou an : I'm a teacher, she's an engineer.
Demande What do you do? pour connaître le métier de quelqu'un.
Dis le lieu : A nurse works in a hospital ; a chef works in a restaurant.
fr.q: Que fais-tu dans la vie, ou que rêverais-tu de faire un jour ?
fr.c: Cite cinq métiers de gens que tu connais et où chacun travaille.

it.g: Impari a dire che lavoro fai e dove lavori.
p: Davanti ai mestieri si mette a o an: I'm a teacher, she's an engineer.
Chiedi What do you do? per sapere che lavoro fa qualcuno.
Di' il luogo: A nurse works in a hospital; a chef works in a restaurant.
it.q: Che lavoro fai, o che lavoro ti piacerebbe fare un giorno?
it.c: Nomina cinque lavori di persone che conosci e dove lavora ciascuno.

pt.g: Aprende a dizer o que fazes na vida e onde trabalhas.
p: Antes da profissão usa-se a ou an: I'm a teacher, she's an engineer.
Pergunta What do you do? para saber a profissão de alguém.
Diz o local: A nurse works in a hospital; a chef works in a restaurant.
pt.q: O que fazes na vida, ou o que adorarias fazer um dia?
pt.c: Diz cinco profissões de pessoas que conheces e onde cada uma trabalha.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda a dizer o que você faz e onde trabalha.
p: Antes da profissão se usa a ou an: I'm a teacher, she's an engineer.
Pergunte What do you do? para saber a profissão de alguém.
Diga o lugar: A nurse works in a hospital; a chef works in a restaurant.
pt_BR.q: O que você faz, ou o que adoraria fazer um dia?
pt_BR.c: Diga cinco profissões de pessoas que você conhece e onde cada uma trabalha.

vocab.ex: I'm a teacher at a primary school.
She's a chef in a hotel.
What do you do? I'm a designer.

target.gram: Jobs need a/an: She's a doctor, he's an artist (not She's doctor). Ask: What do you do?

en.g: Say how often you do things and put the adverb in the right place.
p: From most to least: always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never.
Put them before the main verb: I often cook. She never runs.
But after to be: He is always late. We are sometimes tired.
en.q: What do you always do in the morning, and what do you never do?
en.c: Write six sentences about your habits, one with each adverb.

de.g: Du lernst zu sagen, wie oft du etwas machst, und wohin das Adverb gehört.
p: Von oft zu selten: always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never.
Sie stehen vor dem Hauptverb: I often cook. She never runs.
Aber nach to be: He is always late. We are sometimes tired.
de.q: Was machst du morgens immer, und was machst du nie?
de.c: Schreib sechs Sätze über deine Gewohnheiten, mit jedem Adverb einmal.

es.g: Aprende a decir con qué frecuencia haces cosas y dónde va el adverbio.
p: De más a menos: always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never.
Van antes del verbo principal: I often cook. She never runs.
Pero después de to be: He is always late. We are sometimes tired.
es.q: ¿Qué haces siempre por la mañana y qué no haces nunca?
es.c: Escribe seis frases sobre tus hábitos, una con cada adverbio.

fr.g: Dire à quelle fréquence tu fais les choses et placer l'adverbe au bon endroit.
p: Du plus au moins : always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never.
Ils se placent avant le verbe principal : I often cook. She never runs.
Mais après to be : He is always late. We are sometimes tired.
fr.q: Que fais-tu toujours le matin, et que ne fais-tu jamais ?
fr.c: Écris six phrases sur tes habitudes, une avec chaque adverbe.

it.g: Impari a dire quanto spesso fai le cose e dove mettere l'avverbio.
p: Dal più al meno: always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never.
Vanno prima del verbo principale: I often cook. She never runs.
Ma dopo to be: He is always late. We are sometimes tired.
it.q: Cosa fai sempre la mattina, e cosa non fai mai?
it.c: Scrivi sei frasi sulle tue abitudini, una con ogni avverbio.

pt.g: Aprende a dizer com que frequência fazes as coisas e onde pôr o advérbio.
p: Do mais ao menos: always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never.
Ficam antes do verbo principal: I often cook. She never runs.
Mas depois de to be: He is always late. We are sometimes tired.
pt.q: O que fazes sempre de manhã, e o que nunca fazes?
pt.c: Escreve seis frases sobre os teus hábitos, uma com cada advérbio.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda a dizer com que frequência você faz as coisas e onde colocar o advérbio.
p: Do mais ao menos: always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never.
Ficam antes do verbo principal: I often cook. She never runs.
Mas depois de to be: He is always late. We are sometimes tired.
pt_BR.q: O que você sempre faz de manhã, e o que nunca faz?
pt_BR.c: Escreva seis frases sobre seus hábitos, uma com cada advérbio.

vocab.ex: I always drink water in the morning.

target.gram: Frequency adverbs go before the main verb (I often swim) but after to be (She is never late).

en.t: Review: your first month in English
en.g: Look back at your first month and use everything in a friendly chat.
p: You can greet, introduce yourself, spell your name and say where you are from.
You know to be, numbers, family words, days, months and the time.
You can talk about routines with the present simple, questions, negatives and always or never.
en.q: Introduce yourself to me in five sentences: name, origin, age, job and one daily habit.
en.c: Record or write a short self-introduction in English and compare it with day 4.

de.g: Du schaust auf deinen ersten Monat zurück und nutzt alles in einem lockeren Gespräch.
p: Du kannst grüßen, dich vorstellen, buchstabieren und sagen, woher du kommst.
Du kennst to be, Zahlen, Familie, Wochentage, Monate und die Uhrzeit.
Du sprichst über Routinen mit present simple, Fragen, Verneinung und always oder never.
de.q: Stell dich mir in fünf Sätzen vor: Name, Herkunft, Alter, Beruf und eine Gewohnheit.
de.c: Nimm eine kurze Vorstellung auf Englisch auf oder schreib sie und vergleiche mit Tag 4.

es.t: Repaso: tu primer mes en inglés
es.g: Repasa tu primer mes y úsalo todo en una charla amistosa.
p: Ya sabes saludar, presentarte, deletrear tu nombre y decir de dónde eres.
Conoces to be, los números, la familia, los días, los meses y la hora.
Hablas de rutinas con present simple, preguntas, negativas y always o never.
es.q: Preséntate en cinco frases: nombre, origen, edad, trabajo y un hábito diario.
es.c: Graba o escribe una breve presentación en inglés y compárala con la del día 4.

fr.g: Revenir sur ton premier mois et tout réutiliser dans une conversation amicale.
p: Tu sais saluer, te présenter, épeler ton nom et dire d'où tu viens.
Tu connais to be, les nombres, la famille, les jours, les mois et l'heure.
Tu parles de tes routines au present simple, avec questions, négations, always et never.
fr.q: Présente-toi en cinq phrases : prénom, origine, âge, métier et une habitude.
fr.c: Enregistre ou écris une courte présentation en anglais et compare-la avec le jour 4.

it.t: Ripasso: il tuo primo mese di inglese
it.g: Ripassi il primo mese e usi tutto in una chiacchierata amichevole.
p: Sai salutare, presentarti, fare lo spelling del nome e dire di dove sei.
Conosci to be, i numeri, la famiglia, i giorni, i mesi e l'ora.
Parli di routine con il present simple, domande, negazioni e always o never.
it.q: Presentati in cinque frasi: nome, origine, età, lavoro e un'abitudine quotidiana.
it.c: Registra o scrivi una breve presentazione in inglese e confrontala con quella del giorno 4.

pt.t: Revisão: o teu primeiro mês de inglês
pt.g: Revê o primeiro mês e usa tudo numa conversa descontraída.
p: Já sabes cumprimentar, apresentar-te, soletrar o nome e dizer de onde és.
Conheces to be, números, família, dias, meses e as horas.
Falas de rotinas com o present simple, perguntas, negativas e always ou never.
pt.q: Apresenta-te em cinco frases: nome, origem, idade, profissão e um hábito diário.
pt.c: Grava ou escreve uma pequena apresentação em inglês e compara-a com a do dia 4.

pt_BR.t: Revisão: seu primeiro mês de inglês
pt_BR.g: Revise seu primeiro mês e use tudo numa conversa descontraída.
p: Você já sabe cumprimentar, se apresentar, soletrar o nome e dizer de onde é.
Você conhece to be, números, família, dias, meses e as horas.
Você fala de rotinas com present simple, perguntas, negativas e always ou never.
pt_BR.q: Se apresente para mim em cinco frases: nome, origem, idade, profissão e um hábito diário.
pt_BR.c: Grave ou escreva uma pequena apresentação em inglês e compare com a do dia 4.

vocab.ex: Hi, I'm Ana. Nice to meet you.
I'm from Mexico, but I live in Lisbon.
What do you do? I'm a nurse.
I usually get up at seven.

target.gram: Review: to be (I'm from Peru), present simple (She works, Do you...?, I don't...), always/never.
